note: Client retry policy (one model for every SDK). Classified by status, code and, for 429, the limitType member. expect.code NESTJS_FALLBACK means: no problem code, the fallback form {statusCode, message}. expect.apiKind is the error kind the client reports (other = unknown code or no code).

classes.never: no retry: 400, 401, 403, 404, and 429 with limitType "monthly" or a limitType the client does not know. A REST call never waits for a new quota period: a monthly 429 fails at once, inside searchAll too.
classes.once-after-burst-wait: one retry after exactly Retry-After seconds, 10 when the header is missing: 429 with limitType "burst". On by default, can be turned off (then the error is thrown at once); not counted against maxRetries.
classes.backoff: exponential backoff: 5xx, non-JSON gateway errors and network errors, POST search included

streams: WebSocket outcomes are in ws-sessions/. An exhausted quota (dial 403 "quota exceeded", connection.preempted with reason quota_exceeded) redials once per hour by default (quotaReconnect, quotaReconnectInterval) and passes every wait to the onQuotaWait hook; with quotaReconnect off it is terminal.
requestId: one X-Request-Id per logical call, reused on every retry
